## LTX Video 2.3 Full Quality API

LTX Video 2.3 Full Quality is a text to video and image to video model by Lightricks, available on the Venice API as `ltx-2-v2-3-full-text-to-video`. Requests are anonymized, so the provider never sees your identity.

LTX Video 2.3 Full Quality runs Lightricks' open-weight LTX-2.3 at full quality. This text-to-video variant generates 6-, 8- or 10-second clips at up to 4K, with optional audio.

### LTX Video 2.3 Full Quality API pricing

| Model ID | Variant | Privacy | Price |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ltx-2-v2-3-full-text-to-video` | Text to video | Anonymized | from $0.088 / sec |
| `ltx-2-v2-3-full-image-to-video` | Image to video | Anonymized | from $0.088 / sec |

Clip prices for `ltx-2-v2-3-full-text-to-video`, silent:

| Duration | 1080p | 1440p | 4K |
|---|---|---|---|
| 6s | $0.53 | $1.06 | $2.11 |
| 8s | $0.70 | $1.41 | $2.82 |
| 10s | $0.88 | $1.76 | $3.52 |

### How to use the LTX Video 2.3 Full Quality API

Send requests to `POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/video/queue` with `"model": "ltx-2-v2-3-full-text-to-video"` and your API key.

```bash
# 1. Queue the job (returns a queue_id)
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/video/queue \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "ltx-2-v2-3-full-text-to-video",
    "prompt": "Slow aerial drone shot over a misty mountain valley at golden hour",
    "duration": "6s",
    "resolution": "1080p",
    "aspect_ratio": "16:9",
    "audio": true
  }'

# 2. Poll until the MP4 is ready
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/video/retrieve \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{ "model": "ltx-2-v2-3-full-text-to-video", "queue_id": "<queue_id>" }' --output video.mp4
```
